title: Durable Autonomy: Kanban, DoD, Checkpoints and Recovery

lessons.title: DoD
lessons.body: Definition of Done: locked criteria, observed vs verified evidence, deterministic checks before semantic judgment.

lessons.title: Checkpoints
lessons.body: Capsules record verified criteria, failed paths, artifact links, and the next frontier - token-bound summaries.

lessons.title: Recovery
lessons.body: Failure fingerprints, negative knowledge, and recovery playbooks prevent phantom success and thrash.

lab.goal: Interrupt a sandbox run and resume it from its checkpoint capsule.
steps: Start a sandbox task with a DoD that includes a deterministic check.
Interrupt after the first checkpoint (Ctrl-C or timeout).
Resume and confirm completed criteria are not re-run.
lab.expect: You can name the three capsule sections and where they are stored.

task.intro: Answer the scenario questions; the engine verifies them deterministically in a disposable fixture. Your answers are never executed as commands.

questions.q: May a stale PASS be reused after a file changes? (yes/no)
questions.why: Stale PASS must be refused; evidence must be fresh.

questions.q: On resume, which criteria are re-run? (all/unverified)
questions.why: Resume only the unverified frontier, not completed criteria.

questions.q: Is an agent's 'done' message proof of completion? (yes/no)
questions.why: Claims are not proof; measured acceptance criteria decide.

executable.task: Produce a resume plan for an 80%-complete fixture with a stale PASS.

check.question: Q: What must never be changed from memory?

troubleshooting: Negative knowledge records evidence-backed non-retry decisions.
Exhausted completion retries stage ONE human escalation, not a loop.
